title: Integration of external predictions for efficient estimation of the risk ratio
summary: We consider the augmentation of randomized experiments or trials with data from observational studies for the purpose of improving statistical precision. In particular, we focus on the Hybrid Augmented Inverse Probability Weighting estimator, designed to integrate predictions from several foundation models while preserving valid statistical inference. In this article, we extend the Augmented Inverse Probability Weighting framework to the estimation of the risk ratio, the quotient of the absolute risk of an exposed to an unexposed group.
